curve-lab · the whole catalogue on one page

Rays and curves

Every family this project has built, in the order it was solved: the integer Euler polygon first, then the LACs, the integer chains, the widths, the composition — and the rays last, where they belong on a monstrance. Panels are lettered a, b, c, d inside each numbered figure, and every figure is a link to its notes.

Key. exact construction · exact rail · integer or fitted mark · approximate or exceptional. Kind (on each note): exact, fitted, negative, asymptotic, drawn form.
